en: The postcard features a sepia-toned photograph of a group of people, primarily women, engaged in a traditional dance outdoors. The women are wearing layered skirts, shawls, and bowler hats, which are characteristic of Andean indigenous attire. Some men in the background are dressed in decorated garments and headdresses. There is a thatched-roof building visible in the background, suggesting a rural Andean village setting.
